notes.title: 1.0.6 Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed an error that prevented levels and items from loading under certain conditions
- Text in the ending screens has been fixed

notes.title: 1.0.5 Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed the controller scrolling during the credits
- Updated missing text during CGs under certain conditions
- Improved sprite positions

notes.title: Controller Support and New Languages
notes.content:
Big Update! We've added controller support and new localizations, including: 
- French
- Italian
- German 
- Spanish
- Japanese
- Korean
- Polish
- Portuguese - Brazil
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Turkish

We have also made the following improvements:
- Improved CG UI

Thank you for playing EmyLiveShow visual novels ❤️

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
- Resolution related bugs fixed
- UI optimization
- SFX fixes
- Minor typo fixes
- Added tools that may help with a rare missing cursor bug. If you experience this bug, try unplugging additional input devices if they are connected to your device, or contact us in the comments. 

We plan to add controller input in an upcoming patch!
